# Arm 3 overlay (catalogs)

Lands with T-523 (capability inventory) and T-524 (glossary). Will hold `.story/capabilities.json` (`cap-logging` with entryPoints `src/platform/logging/`, rulings [R1]; `cap-request-routing`, the lexical distractor, entryPoints `src/http/router.ts`) and `.story/glossary.json` ("request id", "redaction"). Every fact these files carry already exists in the core as a note or ruling (see `facts.json`); this overlay adds structure, never facts.
